about: Goldberg & Loren publishes a Portland address in its own structured data and holds verified listings in Portland, New York and Plantation, Florida. 597 reviews at 4.55.
Contingency fees, a free case review and a 24 hour line, published. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach, which is what G5 asks about, and publishes no case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 4 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Oregon does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 13 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 597 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2015-10-15, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: 2 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: B; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 4 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned
